n.bookSourceComment: 得奇小说网 www.deqixs.cc 书源。正文接口带动态token校验：先请求chapter.js.php拿token（有时效，现取现用），再带Referer+XHR头+完整Chrome UA请求ajax2.php，无需Cookie。单结果搜索302跳转书页已兼容。创建于2026-09-04。

ruleContent.content:
<js>var m = String(baseUrl).match(/\/books\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html/);
if (!m) {
    result = '章节地址解析失败: ' + baseUrl;
} else {
    var aid = m[1];
    var cid = m[2];
    var ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36';
    var opt = ',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"' + ua + '","Referer":"' + baseUrl + '","X-Requested-With":"XMLHttpRequest"}}';
    var tokenJs = String(java.ajax('https://www.deqixs.cc/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&referrer=' + baseUrl + opt) || '');
    var t = tokenJs.match(/chapterToken\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
    var s = tokenJs.match(/timestamp\s*=\s*([0-9]+)/);
    var n = tokenJs.match(/nonce\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
    if (!t || !s || !n) {
        result = '获取token失败，请重试';
    } else {
        var apiUrl = 'https://www.deqixs.cc/modules/article/ajax2.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&token=' + t[1] + '&timestamp=' + s[1] + '&nonce=' + n[1] + opt;
        var res = String(java.ajax(apiUrl) || '');
        var json = null;
        try { json = JSON.parse(res); } catch (e) {}
        if (json && json.status == 1 && json.data && json.data.content) {
            result = json.data.content.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n').replace(/ /gi, ' ').replace(/更新不易[\s\S]*?(看最新章节|看最新无错章节|最新小说章节|请订阅)[！!]/g, '').replace(/速\s*读\s*谷|shudugu\.org/g, '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
        } else {
            result = '获取正文失败: ' + (json && json.message ? json.message : res.substring(0, 100));
        }
    }
}</js>
